prompts: Create one finished 16:9 educational presentation IMAGE in Traditional Chinese. Attached reference is ONLY the visual style and typography reference, do not copy its content. Match navy handwritten pen lettering, naturally varying pen pressure, rounded clear Chinese strokes and matching English handwriting; not printed sans-serif, not brush calligraphy, not thin monoline. Warm ivory faint square-grid paper. Simple semantic navy outline icons with sparse light-blue / lavender / turquoise colored-pencil hatching. Restrained coral underline only for one key phrase. Huge readable title and large labels (visual equivalent >=30pt), no small explanatory text. Clean spatial hierarchy, plenty of whitespace, centered balanced layout; safe 6% side margins and bottom 12% completely empty. No page number, no chapter badge, no watermark. No robots, brains, decorative characters, logos, invented scores or logs. Render exact supplied words only; no additional text. Highest available native quality. TITLE centered at top on two lines: "Evaluation 是什麼？" / "實際測試 LLM 的表現". First line larger than second; coral underline under "實際測試". Main diagram in middle: three evenly spaced clear semantic groups with visible left-to-right arrows, not giant boxed cards. LEFT: a task document and a small criteria checklist icon; label "準備任務與成功標準". CENTER: a purple speech-bubble ellipsis representing LLM next to a small tool document icon, label "讓 LLM 實際執行". RIGHT: two documents under one magnifying glass (expected criteria vs actual response), label "對照結果是否達標". These three labels can wrap into two large lines; all labels aligned to same baseline. Add ONE concise takeaway centered at y81%: "不是猜它會不會，而是實際測它做得如何". Keep the takeaway large and not at the very bottom. No all-pass icon or fabricated outcome; depict evaluation as inspection not guaranteed success.
